title: Tic Tac pilots' names told to Bishop before release as a test

tellings.quote: I know you're telling me this cuz you see I'm going to leak stuff about the tic tac incident and pilots whose names hadn't been released yet. I was told don't talk about this.

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer on UFOs, says that someone told him the names of the Navy pilots in the 2004 Tic Tac incident, when pilots reported a white oval object shaped like the mint, before those names were public. He names them as David Fravor and Alex Dietrich, and says he was told not to talk about it. He believes it was a test to see whether he would leak secrets.
